title: Norwegian Wood
author: Haruki Murakami
summary: Looking back at his student days in 1960s Tokyo, Toru remembers the death of his best friend and his fraught relationship with the friend's fragile girlfriend, while a livelier young woman pulls him another way.
readIf: you want a quiet, melancholy coming-of-age novel about grief and loneliness.
skipIf: you expect the surreal side of Murakami, since this is his realistic novel, or suicide is a difficult subject.

pairings.reason: Murakami's far stranger novel, with young protagonists in a world of magical happenings.
Another honest, personal novel of a young person's depression and recovery.
A modern, close look at a young couple and the way they hurt one another.
